entries.translation_en: Did you hear the rumors about<LINE>the Snow Queen mask in the drama<LINE>room?<PAGE>They say whoever wears it is<LINE>cursed to die on stage...<PAGE>It's so terrifying!
The principal has locked all the<LINE>school gates!<LINE>Nobody can leave St. Hermelin<PAGE>High until the demon crisis is<LINE>resolved.<PAGE>What are we going to do?!
Welcome to the school infirmary.<LINE>Let me tend to your wounds<LINE>before you head back out into<PAGE>the hallways.<PAGE>Please stay safe out there.
The library is quiet... but I<LINE>can hear strange whispers from<LINE>the old folklore section.<PAGE>Be careful around the occult<LINE>books. <CLOSE>
SEBEC's security forces have<LINE>sealed off the downtown<LINE>district!<PAGE>They claim it's an industrial<LINE>accident, but we all saw the<LINE>dimensional portal!
I heard Maki Sonomura has been<LINE>hospitalized for months at<LINE>Mikage General...<PAGE>Her mother works as a chief<LINE>engineer at SEBEC, doesn't she?
The Mikage Ruins have suddenly<LINE>appeared near the shrine!<LINE>Ancient demons are pouring out<PAGE>of the subterranean depths!
Welcome to the Velvet Room,<LINE>traveler.<LINE>Here, we assist with the fusion<PAGE>and creation of new Personas.<PAGE>The possibilities of the soul<LINE>are limitless.
Takahisa Kandori has taken<LINE>control of the Deva System.<LINE>He intends to overwrite our<PAGE>reality with a world of his own<LINE>design!<PAGE>You must stop him at all costs!
The Snow Queen's ice is<LINE>spreading across the campus!<LINE>If we don't destroy the three<PAGE>cursed mirrors in the towers,<LINE>the whole school will freeze<LINE>forever!
Hypnos Tower... Nemesis Tower...<LINE>Thanatos Tower...<LINE>Each tower is guarded by a<PAGE>manifestation of human regret<LINE>and sorrow.<PAGE>Steel your resolve, Persona<LINE>users!
Did you hear the rumors about<LINE>the Snow Queen mask in the drama<LINE>room?<PAGE>They say whoever wears it is<LINE>cursed to die on stage...<PAGE>It's so terrifying!
The principal has locked all the<LINE>school gates!<LINE>Nobody can leave St. Hermelin<PAGE>High until the demon crisis is<LINE>resolved.<PAGE>What are we going to do?!
Welcome to the school infirmary.<LINE>Let me tend to your wounds<LINE>before you head back out into<PAGE>the hallways.<PAGE>Please stay safe out there.
